name: home-visit
description: Home Visit — mobile blood-testing platform. Node/Express + MongoDB backend, React/Vite frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit && npm --prefix frontend audit
